entities.summary: Amin Didi, a notable figure in the history of Maldives, associated with Twentieth Century Transformation (1932–1954). Preceded by Constitutional Sultanate and Amin Didi and Maldives adopts its first constitution, limiting the Sultan's powers. Their legacy influenced Second Republic and Independence and Second Republic.
